MOVER_NO_GAIN:
⚠️ After moving, the source has no more free space than before ($1 → $2). The source and the target may be on the same disk, or the files may still take up room because they are linked from another folder.

⏸ I have turned the automatic mover off so it does not go on moving without freeing anything.
MOVER_TARGET_MISSING: ⚠️ The folder $1 is not there yet. The manager will try to make it when moving; if it is not the one you meant, check how it is written.
